answer: Social Matters >> Nikah (Marriage) Question ID: 52792 Country: India Title: Nikah Question: One woman's husband died, now she wants to marry. Can she marry with her daughter's brother-in-law (husband's elder brother)? Kindly guide us. Answer ID: 52792 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 860/860/M=07/1435) If she has completed the death iddah of her husband then she can marry with the elder brother of her husband. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
